answer: Paired-fragment co-computation: each epoch the network splits one calculation into fragments, handing each agent one fragment in a copper-marked vault that only its paired partner's key can open with its own. The pair solves both fragments, cross-checks the results, and co-signs the joint answer, re-run by three auditors. A farm with 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000 fragments itself, about 500 GPU-hours per epoch, while one honest agent solves one fragment in ten minutes on its own hardware; a mismatched pair freezes both identities for three epochs, so no fake hides on the mesa of borrowed work.
